**Tier: T4**
**Why:** Stores health-adjacent screening answers (P1-P7 readiness, injuries) in a new table with RLS, and writes under the coach's tenancy (MacroTarget, program clone + assignment, community memberships, coach notification).
**T4 trigger scan:** (fix round 5, lane B-CONSENT-2: A-607-4 moves the clone-tenant decision inside the completion transaction with the proving membership row locked `FOR SHARE`; cross-tenant write path, no migration/RLS/schema change, T4 retained. Fix round 4, lane B-CONSENT-2: consent-gate change — P0 accepts only `consult-consent-v3` with the exact screen-text sha256 `79ceeb6b...31c9`, byte-identical to mobile #310 f85ffd36; no new migration, RLS or schema change, so T4 retained. Fix round 2: tenancy fence moved inside the completion transaction)  new migration with RLS policies (`20270212000000_clinic_onboarding_intake`, renamed from 20270202000000 so it sorts after main: 3 tables, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, client-self / current-coach / owner policies, append-only revision table with no UPDATE/DELETE policy); new storage of health-screening answers; cross-tenant writes under the attached coach (tenancy-checked); new coach read endpoint gated by roster / sub-coach assignment. Triggered.
**T3 trigger scan:** new client endpoints (`/me/onboarding/*`), new coach endpoint, change to `GET /me/macros/current` response (adds `macro_display_mode`, `simple_until`), seed script.
**Bounded T1:** docs (`docs/clinic-onboarding.md`, README section), draft fixture copy `seed/clinic-programs.v1.json`.
**Builder/owner:** Claude Opus 5.5 (builder). Owner + T4 audit required; builder does not merge.
**Acceptance evidence:** tests listed below (including every Fix round table; fix round 4: `test/onboarding-consent-copy.spec.ts` pins both digests recomputed from the text); A607-3 and A-607-4 live fence proofs in the required `mwb-3-live-tests` job (`test/onboarding-tenancy-fence.live.spec.ts`, 6 cases); live RLS proof in the required `rls-live-tests` job (`test/rls/onboarding-intake-rls.spec.ts`); CI is authoritative. Migration DDL was diffed against `prisma migrate diff` output for the schema change (identical apart from RLS statements and comments).
**Promotion triggers:** already T4. Re-audit if completion is ever made to read the AI consent ledger (D2 forbids it), if the P0 screen text or its version changes on either side (mobile #310 `consentCopyText()` / `CONSENT_COPY_SHA256` and `src/onboarding/consult-consent-copy.ts` must move together), if Roman starts reading intake rows outside the client's own context, or if production seeding is approved.

## C05/C07 backend: consultation intake, idempotent onboarding complete, three-program rule table, seed loader, coach consultation view

Base: `main` (#606 merged). Main merged in by merge commits (no rebase): e5a6044a (#624 S-ENVTRUTH, #626, #623) as `f1eec9a0`, e5d10bd8 (#604) as `7556aa95`.

### Endpoints (full request/response shapes: `docs/clinic-onboarding.md`)
- `PUT /api/me/onboarding/consultation` `{ version: "consult-v1", answers }` -> `{ saved_at, completed_chapters, revision }`. Strict per-key validation that matches the mobile save payload (#310 shapes: B3 `{height_cm, weight_lbs, unit}`, B4 number, `T3_areas`, `P0.copy_version`). Each save appends an immutable revision; nothing is overwritten (owner ruling 18:11).
- **Consent first (privacy ruling 2026-09-30 18:24):** PUT returns `409 consent_missing` unless a current-version consent is on file; the first PUT must carry P0 alone. Answers sent before (or bundled with) the first consent are rejected before any write and never stored (test: `consent before answers`). D2 (fix round 2): P0 is consent box 1 only (waiver + collection/use for coaching), accepted copy version `consult-consent-v3` only (fix round 4), and a P0 counts only with that version's exact screen-text sha256 (`text_sha256`); the verified record is the server-stamped P0 on the intake. Box 2 (AI processing) is recorded separately by R2a and is never read or required here; no dependency on #601.
- **No answers in logs/analytics:** module logs ids and error class names only, emits no analytics; `answers`, `consultation_answers`, `completion_result`, `screening` added to the log redaction list. Unknown/prototype keys are rejected and never written (CodeQL js/remote-property-injection fixed).
- `GET /api/me/onboarding` -> answers, chapters, `missing_required`, consent state, completion state and the frozen result.
- `POST /api/me/onboarding/complete` -> `{ macros, program{id,key,name,days_per_week,weeks,start_date,why[3]}, spaces[], coach, macro_display_mode, simple_until }`. Idempotent (replay returns the stored result, nothing re-assigned; concurrent calls serialised by a claim). 409 `{ code }`: `not_attached`, `consultation_incomplete` (+`missing[]`), `consent_missing`, `clinic_not_configured`, `completion_in_progress`.
- `GET /api/coach/clients/:clientId/consultation[?revision=N]` and `/revisions`: chapters with human-readable question/answer labels, screening items with notes, consent. `@Roles('coach','student')` so the route never answers 403. Readers: the head coach owning the client, an assigned sub-coach, or the head coach of the client's coach. Everyone else (foreign coach, sub-coach of another head, the client) gets 404.
- `GET /api/me/macros/current` adds `macro_display_mode` / `simple_until` (N4 = never -> simple for 7 days; carbs/fat still computed).

### Completion effects
1. Macros via the single C06 calculator; one `MacroTarget` under the coach.
2. Program via the pure rule table (`src/onboarding/program-rules.ts`, first match, ported from the draft fixture). The master is materialised into a client clone owned by the coach (frequency-variant plans, home-dumbbell overrides, extra-care overlay) and fanned out to the client inside the fenced completion transaction (`WorkoutBuilderService.writeProgramAssignmentsInTx`, the same writer `assignProgramToClient` uses; push sent after commit). Tenancy: master must be the verified coach's own non-archived template; coach and client rows are locked `FOR SHARE` and re-checked inside the same transaction. A failed attempt leaves no clone and no assignment. `cloneProgramToClient` is not used or modified.
3. Joins the coach's clinic-wide "All members" cohort and the program cohort (existing community models), `joined_at` = completion time, kept on re-join.
4. Coach flag on any P1-P7 yes / injury: in-app `coach_alert` (no screening details in the body) + `screening_flagged_at`.
5. `onboardingCompleted = true`; result frozen on the intake.

### Seed loader
`scripts/seed-clinic-programs.ts` reads `seed/clinic-programs.v1.json` (draft, sha256 `be932a56...`, `production_seed_authorized: false`). Validates the fixture, refuses rule drift from the code table, checks every slug exists in `ExerciseCatalogItem`, then writes three 4-week masters, one workspace with four cohorts and the `ClinicProgramSet`. Idempotent per (coach, fixture_version). **Refuses production** unless the fixture is owner-approved AND `CLINIC_PROGRAMS_SEED_APPROVED=<version>:<sha256>` is set.

### Data model / RLS (migration `20270212000000_clinic_onboarding_intake`, additive, with `down.sql`)
- `ClientOnboardingIntake`: SELECT client self, current coach (`app.is_current_coach_of`), owner; INSERT/UPDATE client self; anon denied.
- `ClientOnboardingIntakeRevision`: append-only; SELECT as above; INSERT client self; no UPDATE/DELETE policy.
- `ClinicProgramSet`: SELECT owning coach; no public writes.
Roman reads intake only in the client's own context (covered by client-self). Engagement jobs (welcome message, reminders; separate builder) read `completed_at`, `first_session_date` (C1), `preferred_training_time` (S2) columns or `OnboardingService.getEngagementInputs`.

### Tests (local targeted; CI authoritative)
- `test/onboarding-program-rules.spec.ts`: exhaustive 86,400-case matrix vs an oracle (the draft's reference selector run on the fixture's own rules), every rule reachable, named cases, why-template substitution, drift guard.
- `test/onboarding-clinic-programs.spec.ts`: fixture parsing/validation, materialisation of all 9 (program, days, equipment, overlay) variants vs the reference materialiser, extra-care caps, frequency plans, home overrides, master immutability.
- `test/onboarding-consultation-answers.spec.ts`: mobile payload shape, per-key errors, merge/dependent clearing, completeness, mapping (screening never mapped), worked macro example.
- `test/onboarding.service.spec.ts`: all five 409 codes, happy path (MacroTarget, clone-then-assign args, memberships with joined_at, no flag), idempotent replay, claim, screening flag, tenancy refusal + claim release, orphan clone archive + retry, append-only revisions, macro display mode, engagement inputs, coach view labels, sub-coach / head-of-coach access, 404 for foreign coach / other head's sub-coach / the client.
- `test/seed-clinic-programs.spec.ts`: production guard, seeding counts, idempotent re-run, changed-fixture refusal, missing-slug abort, dry run.
- `test/macros-current-self.spec.ts` (display mode).

### Out of scope / follow-ups
- Signup attach and free-package grant (#599 / #595) untouched; complete only requires attachment. No Roman/AI code.
- `consent_missing` uses the P0 acknowledgement (box 1) by design under D2; box 2 is out of scope.
- Coach welcome message and workout reminders (items 6-7) belong to the engagement builder.
- Production seeding awaits owner approval of the program content.

## Fix round 1 (GPT-6.1 Sol BLOCK at `8b9c13c2`; Claude Opus 5.5 partial notes)

Head after fix: `064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f`. The stack was rebased onto the fixed #606 head `3c707694` (the two original commits are now `a74d5c8e`, `e34bc487`, unchanged content) plus one fix commit `064ffbde`. Builder: Claude Opus 5.5 (fix-round builder). Not self-audited; both T4 audits are required at this head. Inherited B606-1/B606-2 are fixed in #606 (`1913e213`).

| Finding | Fix (root cause) | Commit | Regression test |
|---|---|---|---|
| A607-1 stale/cross-head sub-coach grant to health answers | `canCoachRead` no longer trusts `SubCoachScopeService`; one current-tenancy predicate from live rows: client's current coach, current head of that coach, or a sub-coach whose current head is the client's current head with an open assignment issued by that head; live (not deleted) client/coach/reader only. Same rule in SQL as `app.can_read_client_consultation` (SECURITY DEFINER, pinned search_path) used by both intake SELECT policies. The attach-code transfer closes open sub-coach assignments in the same transaction. | `064ffbde` | `test/onboarding-audit-regressions.spec.ts` (audit reproduction with the REAL `SubCoachScopeService` -> 404, revision row never read; attach transfer retires assignments); `test/onboarding.service.spec.ts` "A607-1" (transfer, moved sub-coach, revoked, cross-head assignment, deleted users, `sub_coach` role); live `test/rls/onboarding-intake-rls.spec.ts` (same scenarios on Postgres) |
| A607-2 safety change after partial completion replayed the older higher-intensity clone | Selection is always recomputed from the answers being completed (the frozen-key reuse is removed); `withIdempotency` key = (revision, selection fingerprint); inside the fenced final transaction every other not-started onboarding clone for the client is unassigned and archived; saves during a live completion claim return 409 `completion_in_progress`. | `064ffbde` | `test/onboarding.service.spec.ts` "A607-2" (audit reproduction: advanced/gym/4-day assigned, finalisation fails, P1=yes, retry -> Steady Foundations 2 days, new clone, old clone's assignments removed and archived, one program left; plain retry reuses the clone; edit during live claim -> 409) |
| B607-1 concurrent partial saves lost answers | Compare-and-swap on `current_revision` (and claim token) with bounded retry; revision append and profile sync in the same transaction as the CAS; P2002 on simultaneous first saves retried (Opus note: no 500); exhausted retries -> 409 `save_conflict`. | `064ffbde` | `test/onboarding.service.spec.ts` "B607-1" (audit reproduction G1 || B1 -> both kept, revisions 2 and 3; two simultaneous first saves; bounded retry -> 409) |
| B607-2 lease expiry allowed duplicate macro/notification effects | Claim carries a fencing token + claimed revision; the final transaction first completes the row conditionally on (token, revision) and only then writes MacroTarget, spaces, coach alert, profile flag, completion revision and completion hooks; a fenced-off worker rolls back, releases only its own claim, retires its clone if it assigned after the winner, and returns the winner's replay. `ONBOARDING_COMPLETION_HOOKS` run inside the fence for the welcome-message scheduler. | `064ffbde` | `test/onboarding.service.spec.ts` "B607-2" (audit reproduction worker 1 paused, worker 2 at +120001 ms -> one MacroTarget, one alert, one complete revision; stale worker assigning after the winner retires its clone; hooks once; failing hook rolls everything back). The in-memory Prisma double now rolls back transactions like Postgres. |
| B607-3 no live RLS proof / API-RLS audience parity | `rls-live-tests` now bootstraps the minimal extra relations, applies the onboarding migration VERBATIM, grants Supabase-default table privileges, and runs `test/rls/onboarding-intake-rls.spec.ts` as non-bypass `authenticated`/`anon` with production GUCs. | `064ffbde` | Parity matrix (7 readers x 3 clients: API `canCoachRead` on a real PrismaClient == RLS SELECT on intake AND revisions) at baseline and after transfer, moved sub-coach, revoked assignment, soft delete; client self-only; INSERT self-only (coach/other client forged insert rejected); coach UPDATE 0 rows; no re-owning; revision UPDATE/DELETE 0 rows; no public ClinicProgramSet writes; anon denied; RLS forced + helper SECURITY DEFINER. Platform owner is the documented difference (RLS `is_owner()` yes, coach API no). Pre-consent storage refusal is an API rule, covered by the existing consent-first service tests. |
| Opus note: non-coach roles got 403 instead of 404 | `@Roles` on the coach consultation controller lists every Prisma `Role` value (`coach, student, owner, sub_coach`); `AppRole` gains `sub_coach` (exact match only, no inheritance, so no other route widens). | `064ffbde` | `test/onboarding-audit-regressions.spec.ts` (metadata equals the Role enum; `roleSatisfies` admits each; client routes stay student-only) |

Schema: `ClientOnboardingIntake` gains `completion_claim_token TEXT`, `completion_claim_revision INTEGER` (in the unmerged migration `20270202000000_clinic_onboarding_intake`, edited in place; `down.sql` drops the new helper).

How CI ran: workflows only run on PRs into `main`, so after pushing `064ffbde` I temporarily retargeted this PR to `main` (as the previous round did), let the full suite run (first on `fd6d7d2f`: one failure, the #606 parity spec's Prisma double lacked the intake read #607 adds; fixed in #606 `3c707694` and the stack rebased; then on `064ffbde`: every required check SUCCESS, including build-and-test and rls-live-tests with the new intake suite passing, 45/45 live RLS tests), then restored the base to `agent/clinic/c06-macros/a4e4fb63`. Before merge: merge #606 first (GitHub then retargets this PR to main) or retarget to main again for a fresh run if anything else is pushed.

Local tests (targeted jest `--maxWorkers=1`, serialized through the shared heavy-job queue): onboarding.service (38), onboarding-audit-regressions (+ invite-codes.service, 76 total across the three), roles-enforced, roles.guard, invite-codes-redeemers, team-mode-invite-attribution, route-doc-drift, onboarding-consultation-answers (46 total across the six). The live RLS suite cannot run locally (no Postgres); it runs in CI. The commit went through the repo pre-commit hooks (R75, eslint, prettier, full `tsc --noEmit`).

Non-required checks: `shellcheck (scripts/*.sh)` fails on pre-existing SC2015 infos in `scripts/s10-core-diff-gate.sh` (file untouched; the job runs because this PR adds files under `scripts/ci/`).



## Fix round 2 (GPT-6.1 Sol BLOCK at `064ffbde`; D2 consent contract)

Head after fix: `245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53`. The stack was rebased onto the new #606 head `7e00de0c` (B606-3); the three earlier commits are unchanged in content (`e865cf6`, `8f2fee6`, `109bc9d`) plus one fix commit `245da2e7`. Builder: Claude Opus 5.5 (fix-round builder). Not self-audited; both T4 audits are required at this head. The three-program fixture is byte-identical (`sha256sum seed/clinic-programs.v1.json` = `be932a56ae09f85ebcf8a04f29703f01a8b54e99518b452af1532f90f09e1d50`).

| Finding | Fix (root cause) | Commit | Regression test |
|---|---|---|---|
| A607-3 finalisation could write for a former coach | Every completion effect now runs in ONE transaction whose first statements lock the coach `User` row then the client `User` row `FOR SHARE` (`lockUserRow`, parameterised) and re-verify: coach live with role coach/owner, client live student whose `coach_id` is that coach. The attach-code transfer's `UPDATE "User" SET coach_id` conflicts with the share lock, so it waits until the completion commits or rolls back; a transfer committed earlier is seen and the transaction rolls back (`TenancyChangedError`) before the claim fence or any write. `complete()` then re-runs once from the pre-checks against the CURRENT attachment (bounded: 2 attempts, then 409 `completion_in_progress`). Clinic set, masters, cohorts, MacroTarget, memberships, coach alert, hooks and assignments are all keyed by the verified coach. Lock order is fixed (coach, client) everywhere. | `245da2e7` | `test/onboarding.service.spec.ts` "A607-3": audit reproduction (P1=yes, transfer A -> B after pre-checks/claim, before finalisation: no MacroTarget, space, screening alert, clone, assignment, push or welcome hook for A; claim released; B not set up -> `clinic_not_configured`); transfer to a B with a clinic set -> everything under B, nothing mentions A; detach -> `not_attached`; coach deleted -> `not_attached`; flapping attachment -> bounded, 409; lock order coach then client, `FOR SHARE`. Live Postgres `test/onboarding-tenancy-fence.live.spec.ts` (in `mwb-3-live-tests`): transfer UPDATE blocks (`pg_stat_activity` Lock wait) while the fence is held and lands only after; committed transfer is seen by the fence; SQL valid against the real schema. |
| A607-2-R1 / B607-2-R1 program assignment ran outside the fence | The clone, the assignment rows and their plan snapshots are now written inside the fenced final transaction (`writeProgramTree(tx)` + `WorkoutBuilderService.writeProgramAssignmentsInTx(tx, ...)`, extracted from `assignProgramToClient` with identical row/snapshot logic). The out-of-transaction `withIdempotency` assignment and the clone-retire-after-the-fact path are removed; idempotency is the claim fence + frozen result. The assignment push is sent only after commit (`notifyProgramAssigned`). A fenced-off, tenancy-changed or failed worker therefore leaves nothing to clean up. Transaction runs with `timeout: 30s`, `maxWait: 10s`. | `245da2e7` | "B607-2": NEW no-winning-worker reproduction (worker paused before its final transaction, claim expires, client saves P1=yes, worker resumes -> no clone, no assignment, no MacroTarget, no alert, no push, 409 `completion_in_progress`; the next complete -> Steady Foundations 2 days, only that program assigned); two-worker case -> one clone, one assignment set, one push; stale worker after winner writes nothing and replays the winner. "A607-2": failed finalisation leaves no clone/assignment, P1=yes retry -> Foundations; plain retry assigns once. Happy path asserts in-tx assignment args and exactly one post-commit push. `test/workout-builder.service.spec.ts` passes unchanged (assign path refactor). |
| D2 consent contract | `DEFAULT_CONSULT_CONSENT_COPY_VERSION = 'consult-consent-v2'` (box 1); completion requires box 1 only (`consent_missing`); box 2 never read, never required; no import of #601/R2a code; docs updated. | `245da2e7` | "D2 consent": v1 rejected by default, v2 stamped; env override still works; complete succeeds with no AI consent; box-2 keys inside P0 -> 400 `invalid_answers`, nothing stored; static check that `src/onboarding` imports no AI-consent module. Existing consent specs moved to v2. |
| B606-3 (inherited) intake profile sync could race PUT /profile | The intake save writes the profile through #606's `writeProfileWithTargets(tx, ..., 'allow_incomplete')` (same row lock, merge onto the committed row, targets = calculator(stored row) or cleared when not computable). | `245da2e7` | #606 `test/profile-put-concurrency*.spec.ts`; onboarding profile-mapping tests pass on the shared path. |
| C607-1 shellcheck SC2015 (optional) | Not fixed: pre-existing in untouched `scripts/s10-core-diff-gate.sh`, infra lane. | - | - |

Local tests (targeted, `--runInBand`, through the shared heavy-job queue): `npx jest --runInBand test/onboarding.service.spec.ts test/onboarding-audit-regressions.spec.ts test/onboarding-consultation-answers.spec.ts test/onboarding-program-rules.spec.ts test/onboarding-clinic-programs.spec.ts test/seed-clinic-programs.spec.ts test/onboarding-tenancy-fence.live.spec.ts test/workout-builder.service.spec.ts test/macros-current-self.spec.ts test/profile-put-recompute.spec.ts test/profile-put-concurrency.spec.ts test/profile-lean-onboarding-contract.spec.ts` -> 11 suites passed, 1 skipped (live; no local Postgres), 187 tests passed, 3 skipped. `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` -> exit 0. eslint/prettier/R75 clean on changed files. Live suites run only in CI. This PR is stacked on #606, so CI does not run here; it is ready for CI once the operator retargets (or after #606 merges).

## Fix round 4 (lane B-CONSENT-2, agent 111): consult-consent-v3 exactly as mobile #310 defines it

Head after fix: `b74384fb3915f3b482384ddddb609e618bd8bc36` (fast-forward from `e8feb0d2`: two merge commits of main, then one fix commit). Builder: Claude Opus 5.5. Not self-audited; both T4 audits are required at this head.

Why: mobile #310 `f85ffd36` changed paragraph 4 of the P0 screen to the true AI-chat retention sentence ("...private from your coach and are kept until you delete them or delete your account.", owner 2026-10-01 20:32, OR-110-1; ledger copy `client-ai-v4`, backend #635), so the screen version moved to `consult-consent-v3` and #607 still accepted only v2 (every v3 P0 would have been `409 consent_missing`).

| Item | Change | Commit | Test that proves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Accept v3 exactly (version string) | `DEFAULT_CONSULT_CONSENT_COPY_VERSION = 'consult-consent-v3'`. v3 only: v1, v2 (no live client ever recorded v2; the intake table is not deployed) or any other version is `409 consent_missing` before any write. | `b74384fb` | `onboarding.service.spec` "the accepted P0 copy is consult-consent-v3 with its exact text digest; v1 and v2 are not current" (also v2 carrying the v3 digest is refused) |
| Combined sha256 | A P0 counts only when `text_sha256` equals the pinned sha256 of the version's whole screen (`currentConsentVersionOf`). Missing digest, another digest, or the box-2 copy digest -> `409 consent_missing`, nothing stored; malformed digest -> `400 invalid_answers`. | `b74384fb` | "a v3 P0 without the exact v3 text digest is not consent and nothing is stored"; `onboarding-consent-copy.spec` truth table |
| Byte-exact text parity | New `src/onboarding/consult-consent-copy.ts`: the v3 screen text (title, paragraphs 1-3, box 1, paragraph 4, box 2, footer, joined with `"\n\n"`, straight apostrophes). sha256 = `79ceeb6b8316ee9e3f583fe678e2463584c6dda4c93b5c95746dfe5c52ef31c9` = mobile `CONSENT_COPY_SHA256`; paragraph 4 + box 2 = `fbf821401d4313c6a301a6cc08d3870bb117c293fbb970e321bf87f49abe34f4` = mobile `AI_CONSENT_COPY_SHA256` = ledger `client-ai-v4` copy sha256 (#635). The onboarding module still imports nothing from the ledger (D2). Builder cross-check: the mobile f85ffd36 `consentCopyText()` transpiled and hashed locally gives both values (1613 bytes). | `b74384fb` | `onboarding-consent-copy.spec`: both digests recomputed from the text equal the pins and the mobile pins; display order + separator; 1613 UTF-8 bytes; retention sentence; no "180 days", no `!`, no emoji, no curly quotes; registry knows v3 only; existing static "no ledger import" check still passes |
| One consent truth for save, GET and complete | `onFileConsentVersion(intake)`: server stamp + stamped version accepted + stored P0 still proves that version's text. Used by the consent-first save gate, `GET /me/onboarding` `consent_recorded` (now false for a stale or unprovable record, so the app sends P0 first) and the completion gate. | `b74384fb` | "a stored P0 that no longer proves the v3 text is not on file..." (consent_recorded false, answers refused, re-sent v3 restores); "consent_missing at complete when the stored consent is not a current, provable v3 record" (v2 stamp, tampered digest, stamp/P0 version split, no stamp) |
| `CONSULT_CONSENT_COPY_VERSIONS` | Kept, but it may only choose among versions whose exact text the server knows; unknown names are ignored and logged once; a list with no known name falls back to v3. Registered in `ENV_RULES` (S-ENVTRUTH: optional, real default, no validator, per the inventory rule) and documented (commented, unset) in `.env.example`. | `b74384fb` | "CONSULT_CONSENT_COPY_VERSIONS only chooses among versions with known text"; `onboarding-consent-copy.spec` env-rule block; `prod-readiness/env-registration.spec` (zero unregistered reads, hygiene) |
| Docs | `docs/clinic-onboarding.md`: P0 payload with `text_sha256`, the "server stores what was shown" rule, v3 everywhere, `consent_missing` row. | `b74384fb` | - |

Mobile #310 needs no change for this round: at `f85ffd36` it sends exactly `{ agreed: true, copy_version: 'consult-consent-v3', agreed_at, text_sha256: CONSENT_COPY_SHA256 }` on the first P0-only PUT and resends the stored P0 on later saves, and it maps `409 consent_missing` back to the agreement screen. Release order: #607 and mobile #310 ship together (a v2 build would be refused).

Local (all through `ops/heavy.sh`, `--runInBand`): `npx jest --runInBand test/onboarding-consent-copy.spec.ts test/onboarding.service.spec.ts test/onboarding-consultation-answers.spec.ts test/onboarding-audit-regressions.spec.ts test/prod-readiness/env-registration.spec.ts test/prod-readiness/env-discovery.spec.ts test/c13-fix-round.spec.ts test/module-graph.spec.ts` -> 8/8 suites, 318/318 tests passed; `npx jest --runInBand test/env-validation.spec.ts test/deploy-readiness.spec.ts` -> 2/2 suites, 85 passed, 1 skipped. `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` -> exit 0. eslint `--max-warnings 0` on the 8 changed TS files -> exit 0; prettier clean on changed files (env-validation.ts left in main's formatting); `node scripts/check-r75.js --mode=range --base=origin/main --head=HEAD` -> OK, no positive token change.
